messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: In children and teenagers taking sertraline for depression, there was a difference in weight change of roughly 1 kg compared with placebo over 10 weeks.
This difference represented slight weight loss on sertraline.
This difference represented slight weight gain on placebo.
Around 7% of children lost more than 7% of their body weight, compared with none on placebo.
In a longer 34 week extension study, weight gain was similar to what would be expected for their age.
Height and weight should be monitored in younger patients.
Tell your doctor about any weight change that concerns you.
Does sertraline make you tired or sleepy?
:
It can.
Sleepiness was reported by 11% of adults taking sertraline in trials.
This was compared with 6% on placebo.
Tiredness was reported by 12%.
This was compared with 8%.
Sertraline can also affect how clearly you think and how quickly you react.
Do not drive or use machinery until you know how it affects you.
Is sertraline a controlled substance?
:
No.
Sertraline is not a controlled substance.
A study compared sertraline with alprazolam and d-amphetamine.
Triplet: ["sertraline", "compared with", "alprazolam"]

The relation 'compared with' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is being compared to the object entity in a study or clinical trial.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'tested in': The subject drug was evaluated in the clinical trial specified by the object entity.
B. 'has study result': The subject drug is associated with the study result specified by the object entity.
C. 'has clinical importance for': The subject drug has clinical significance or relevance to the medical situation or process specified by the object entity.
D. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
E. 'differs from': The subject drug is distinct from or not the same as the substance or category specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
